punchline: In Tomsk's prisons one in four patients on TB therapy was dying; Farmer chose to track that.
thirty_sec: PIH began working in the prisons of Tomsk Oblast in 1998; Farmer has said 24 percent of those on TB and MDR-TB therapy there were dying, and that after the right drugs reached the right place it fell to zero within two years.
question: What one figure would a customer or patient call the real measure?
key_contrast: Track the outcome that matters, not the activity.
